Definition: to separate, literally (to disperse) or figuratively (to specify); also (by implication) to wound
BiblicalUsage: 1) to make distinct, declare, distinguish, separate; 1a) (Qal) to declare, clarify; 1b) (Pual) to be distinctly declared; 2) (Hiphil) to pierce, sting; 3) (Niphal) scatter
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
